hero.title: The Three Jewels (Triratna) of Buddhism
hero.description: The fundamental pillars of Buddhist faith and practice, essential for the path to Nirvana.

sections.title: 1. Core Study Notes
sections.content:
Core Components

  • Buddha: The Enlightened One
  • Dhamma: Cosmic Law/Doctrine
  • Sangha: Monastic Community

Significance

  • Basis of 'Saranagamana' (Refuge)
  • Universal ethical framework

Structure of Triratna

  • Buddha: Not just a god, but an idealized human who attained Enlightenment (Bodhi).
  • Dhamma: The Four Noble Truths and Eightfold Path as the essence of the teaching.
  • Sangha: The collective of monks and nuns who preserve the tradition.
JewelMeaning
BuddhaThe Guide
DhammaThe Path
SanghaThe Order

timeline.description: Evolution from the life of Buddha to the codification in the Tripitaka.

items.title: B-D-S
items.decryption: The standard sequence: The Teacher (Buddha), The Teaching (Dhamma), The Community (Sangha).

items: Confusing Triratna of Buddhism with the Triratna of Jainism (Right Faith, Right Knowledge, Right Conduct).
Assuming the Sangha was open to everyone without distinction; monks had different rules than lay followers (Upasakas).
